{{Quote|We expect hundreds of submissions and will be excited to pick the painting that best represents the ongoing efforts of our rebellion|Unknown [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] spokesman|<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Calling on All Artists">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67761&month=052008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Calling on All Artists}}</ref>}}
The '''Rebel Alliance Painting Contest''' was an art contest that occurred twice in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==History==
{{Quote|And...just between you and me, the Rebellion also hired me to distribute a painting created by one their own, on the downlow of course.|[[Navari Trik]]|<ref name="SWG:NT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Navari Trik|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
After [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] announced details concerning the planned [[Galactic Empire Painting Contest]], the Rebel Alliance responded by holding their own contest. The Alliance challeneged all painters who were sympathetic to the Rebellion to create the greatest Rebellion masterpiece ever, and submit it for possible selection.

The first painting selected under this contest was titled, ''[[The March to Restuss|The March To Restuss]]''. Later, another contest was enacted, where the painting ''[[Preparing for the Storm]]'' was selected.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Alliance Painting Contest was featured in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as part of its "Create a Painting Contest."
